name: io.github.liujycode/mcu-debug-mcp
title: mcu-debug-mcp
description: Embedded debug MCP: serial, flash verify, fault decode, 45-pattern log analyzer, driver library

environmentVariables.name: MCU_DEBUG_MCP_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Isolation mode: readonly (default) or write. Controls whether serial write/flash operations are allowed

environmentVariables.name: MCU_DEBUG_MCP_PORT_DENY
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated port denylist (e.g. COM6,COM28); supports * wildcard; DENY overrides ALLOW
